process_tensors_from_config: apply nonensembled and ensembled map functions to tensors based on a data config for AlphaFold input pipeline
nonensembled_map_fns: build a list of nonensembled data transform functions including MSA correction, masking, and template processing from a data config
ensembled_map_fns: build a list of ensemblable data transform functions including MSA sampling, masking, clustering, and cropping from a data config
compose: compose a list of data transform functions into a single pipeline function that applies each transform sequentially
wrap_ensemble_fn: wrap ensembled map functions over an ensemble dimension index to produce separate batched tensor outputs for AlphaFold recycling
